text:
Alex: T-minus 45 until the staging canary (12:30 UTC). Quick async preflight — who is the rollback owner, who runs the smoke, and any open blockers? Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/escape-hatch-v4 (please check step 2b for toggle details).

Mira: I'm on rollback ownership for this window — I'll be standing by and will coordinate the rollback ops. No blockers from infra side.

Jia: I own the smoke script. Confirmed smoke script v2 at ops/runbooks/smoke.sh. My smoke checks: 
- p95 latency < 300ms (api layer)
- error rate < 0.5%
- embeddings throughput within 10% of baseline
I'll run smoke at +5m after traffic switch and post a short summary here.

Sam: I can handle DB toggle and cache invalidation if we need to roll back. If rollback is triggered I'll run `./revert-prev-deploy.sh --fast` and revert DB toggle. I'll be available at deploy window.

Mira: Rollback criteria proposal (we'll treat as hard thresholds): 
1) Error rate spike > 1.0% sustained for 2 minutes across canary hosts.
2) p95 API latency > 600ms for 60s.
3) Canary health checks fail (>=2 failing checks for 3 consecutive runs).
If any of these happen, rollback = start within 3 minutes.

Alex: Sounds good. Minor ask: add an explicit abort trigger for product regression test failing automated QA (if QA job fails, treat as go-no-go).

Jia: ack. Smoke script quick checklist (I'll run):
```
1) curl /health -> 200
2) run synthetic prompt batch (10 reqs) -> compare embeddings similarity to baseline
3) run 30s steady-state rps @ 20r/s -> monitor p95 and errors
```
I'll paste the short table of results here when done.

release-bot: Scheduled canary start at 12:30 UTC. Notifying oncall and ops-rotation.

Mira: Final preflight ack: Mira: ✅, Alex: ✅, Jia: ✅, Sam: ✅. No outstanding blockers. Proceed with canary at 12:30 UTC.

Alex: If rollback happens, post immediate message here and ping #product and #support. Also assign postmortem owners: Alex + Mira.

Jia: Will upload smoke logs to s3://redwood-smoke/2759998888/ and paste a 1-line summary here. I'll also attach the raw script run.

Sam: I'll keep the DB toggle command ready: `./toggle-db.sh --env staging --off` and the revert command available.

Mira: Thanks all — I'll call the go/no-go in the canary window based on the smoke outputs and metrics. If anyone needs to step out, reply here now.

Alex: I'm online. Good luck everyone :rocket:
